urls.rationale: Chapter 112 (Public Officers and Employees: General Provisions) houses Part III - Code of Ethics, which includes F.S. 112.3215, the executive-branch lobbyist registration and compensation reporting statute administered by the Florida Commission on Ethics.

notes: Chapters 110, 111, 113-122 cover state employment, public records, administrative procedure, retirement systems, and notaries - none touch lobbying registration or disclosure.
